_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

name.description: Name of the reason code; used as its display value in other collections

level.description: Level number on the scale of the parent record

parentReasonCodeId.description: Reference to u_mes_perf_reasonCode._id: parent reason code

parentReasonCodeName.description: Display value of parentReasonCodeId, copied from u_mes_perf_reasonCode.name

pathText.description: Full path of the reason from level 1 to this level

reasonCategoryName.description: Display value of reasonCategoryId, copied from u_mes_perf_reasonCategory.name

lossCategoryName.description: Display value of lossCategoryId, copied from u_mes_perf_lossCategory.name

isPlanned.description: True when the record is planned

responsibleDepartmentName.description: Display value of responsibleDepartmentId, copied from u_mes_mast_department.name

requiresMaintenanceWorkOrder.description: True when maintenance work order is required

sequenceNo.description: Position of this document in its list (within the same parent for child collections), starting at 1

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
